vision.name: Guru
vision.text:
(If your MP is Dende or Nail, you may use this Power regardless of your MP's power stage and once per combat when this Ally enters play, draw a card.)
[Continuous]: Your MP's PUR is +1.
POWER: Rejuvenate 1. You cannot win by MPPV this turn. Once per game, if your MP has [Trait:Namekian] or [Trait:Earthling], you may banish "Guru, Great Elder" to advance your MP 1 level. At the end of combat, lower your MP 1 level.
vision.note: Organized Play card (OP1); edge reads 'HERO ALLY'; Trait badges G (gold), N (orange); inline icons zoomed: orange N then blue E
